        loss_scale: Scalar multiplier applied to all losses.
        priority: Per-loss priority weighting tuple.

        use_adaptive_weights: Enable gradient-based adaptive loss weighting.
        adaptive_alpha: Update smoothing factor for adaptive weighting.
        update_weights_every: Interval (epochs) between weight updates.
        update_weights_after: Epoch after which adaptive weighting begins.

        balance_magnitudes: Normalize loss magnitudes once at training start.
        magnitude_clip: Maximum allowed down-scaling during magnitude balancing.

        early_stopping: Enable early-stopping logic.
        patience: Allowed epochs without improvement.
        rel_tolerance: Required fractional improvement between epochs.

        seed: Random seed for model initialization.
        verbosity: Print constructed components for debugging.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If mutually dependent inputs contradict (e.g., domain/time mismatch).
        ValueError: If ``path`` dimensionality does not match the domain.
        ValueError: If geometry sampling or residual assignment is inconsistent.
        ValueError: If the model or training configurations contain invalid types.

    Notes:
        - If ``model`` is provided, all model-construction arguments are ignored.
        - If ``training`` is provided, all training-related arguments are ignored.
        - Default behaviour aims to allow minimal user input while still producing a
          fully defined PINN experiment suitable for direct training.

    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        time: pinnjax.Time | bool | None = None,
        domain: pinnjax.Domain | None = None,
        path: pinnjax.Path | pinnjax.PathConfig | bool | None = None,
        geometry: pinnjax.ComplexShape | None = None,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork | None = None,
        training: pinnjax.Training | None = None,
        sampling_method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod | None = None,
        sampling_values: float | list[int | float] | None = None,
        sampling_mode: Literal["grid_resolution", "point_count", "density"]
        | None = None,
        loss_function: pinnjax.Loss | None = None,
        residual_functions: list[pinnjax.Residual] | pinnjax.Residual | None = None,
        topology: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
        output_dimensions: int | None = None,
        activation: pinnjax.Activation | None = None,
        initialization: pinnjax.Initialization | None = None,
        optimization: pinnjax.Optimization | None = None,
        input_transformation: pinnjax.InputTransformation | None = None,
        output_transformation: pinnjax.OutputTransformation | None = None,
        hard_constraint: pinnjax.HardConstraint
        | tuple[pinnjax.HardConstraint, ...]
        | None = None,
        add_path_shapes: bool = False,
        optimizer: pinnjax.Optimizer | None = None,
        learning_rate: float | Callable | None = None,
        epochs: int | None = None,
        train_mode: str | None = None,
        loss_scale: float | None = None,
        priority: tuple[int | float, ...] | None = None,
        use_adaptive_weights: bool | None = None,
        adaptive_alpha: float | None = None,
        update_weights_every: int | None = None,
        update_weights_after: int | None = None,
        balance_magnitudes: bool | None = None,
        magnitude_clip: float | None = None,
        early_stopping: bool = False,
        patience: int | None = None,
        rel_tolerance: float | None = None,
        seed: int | None = None,
        verbosity: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        # ------------------- Domain and Time -------------------
        if (
            domain is not None
            and time is not None
            and isinstance(domain, pinnjax.Domain)
            and isinstance(time, pinnjax.Time)
            and domain.times != time
        ):
            msg = "The time-dependent domain 'time' DOES NOT match the inputted 'time'."
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if time is None or time is True:
            if domain is not None and isinstance(domain, pinnjax.Domain):
                self.time = domain.times
            else:
                self.time = pinnjax.Time(0, 3, 0.05)
        elif time is False:
            self.time = None
        elif isinstance(time, pinnjax.Time):
            self.time = time
        else:
            msg = f"Inputted time is not of type pinnjax.Time, rather {type(time)}."
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)

        if verbosity:
            _CONFIG.logger.info(self.time)

        if domain is None:
            self.domain = pinnjax.Domain(
                min=(0, 0, 0),
                max=(4e-2, 6e-3, 4e-3),
                times=self.time,
            )
        elif isinstance(domain, pinnjax.Domain):
            self.domain = domain
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Inputted domain is not of type pinnjax.Domain, rather {type(domain)}."
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)

        if verbosity:
            _CONFIG.logger.info(self.domain)

        # ------------------- Path -------------------
        if (path is None or path is True) and self.time is not None:
            waypoints = pinnjax.line_waypoint_generator(
                speed=0.01,
                direction=(1, 0, 0),
                initial=(0.0, 3e-3, 4e-3),
                time=self.time,
                segments=60,
            )
            path_config = pinnjax.ComplexLinearPathConfig(
                waypoints=waypoints,
                is_temporal=True,
                active=True,
            )
            self.path = pinnjax.create_path(path_config)
            self.path.validate(self.domain)
        elif path is False:
            self.path = None
        else:
            if isinstance(path, pinnjax.PathConfig):
                path = pinnjax.create_path(config=path)
            if isinstance(path, pinnjax.Path):
                if path.dimensions != len(self.domain.min):
                    msg = (
                        "Inputted path and domain dont have the "
                        "same spatial dimensions."
                    )
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if self.time is None:
                    msg = (
                        "This is not a time-dependent domain, "
                        "and thus cant have a path."
                    )
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if len(self.domain.min) == 1:
                    msg = "Pathing not compatible with 1D domains."
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                self.path = path
                self.path.validate(self.domain)
            else:
                msg = f"Inputted path is not of type pinnjax.Path, rather {type(path)}."
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

        self.spatial_dimensions = len(self.domain.min)

        # ------------------- Geometry -------------------
        if geometry is None:
            obb = self.domain.to_obb()
            match len(obb[0]):
                case 1:
                    geometry = pinnjax.BoundedLine(*obb, times=self.time)
                case 2:
                    geometry = pinnjax.BoundedRectangle(*obb, times=self.time)
                case 3:
                    geometry = pinnjax.BoundedBox(*obb, times=self.time)
            if add_path_shapes and self.path is not None:
                three_dimensions = 3
                if self.spatial_dimensions == three_dimensions:
                    geometry.add_path_shape(
                        self.path,
                        radius=(1e-10, 0.0025, 0.0035),
                    )
                else:
                    msg = (
                        f"Spatial Dimensions of {self.spatial_dimensions} "
                        "not compatible with additional path shapes."
                    )
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
            if sampling_method is None:
                self.sampling_mode = "point_count" or sampling_mode
                self.sampling_method = pinnjax.SobolSampler(mode=self.sampling_mode)

            elif isinstance(sampling_method, pinnjax.SamplingMethod):
                self.sampling_method = sampling_method

            # TODO(@mjryande) This appears incorrect.
            if sampling_values is None:
                self.sampling_values = 0.1
            else:
                if isinstance(sampling_values, (list, int, float)) and isinstance(
                    sampling_values, list
                ):
                    self.sampling_values = sampling_values
                elif len(sampling_values) != len(geometry.shapes):
                    msg = (
                        f"Number of sampling_values [{len(sampling_values)}]"
                        f" DOES NOT match number of shapes "
                        f"[{len(geometry.shapes)}]"
                    )
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                else:
                    msg = f"Invalid 'sampling_values' type: {type(sampling_values)}"
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise TypeError(msg)

            geometry.samples(self.sampling_method, sampling_values)
            geometry.unpack(flatten=True)

            if loss_function is None:
                self.loss_function = pinnjax.ResidualMSError()
            geometry.assign_loss(self.loss_function)

            if residual_functions is None:
                msg = "If 'geometry' is not defined, 'residual_functions' must be."
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)

            if isinstance(residual_functions, (list, pinnjax.Residual)):
                if isinstance(residual_functions, list):
                    for residual_function in residual_functions:
                        if not isinstance(residual_function, pinnjax.Residual):
                            msg = (
                                "One or more of the residuals in 'residual_functions' "
                                f"is not of type pinnjax.Residual, "
                                f"rather {type(residual_function)}."
                            )
                            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                            raise TypeError(msg)
            else:
                msg = f"Invalid 'residual_functions' type: {type(residual_functions)}"
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

            self.residual_functions = residual_functions
            geometry.assign_residuals(residual_functions)
            self.geometry = geometry

        elif not isinstance(geometry, pinnjax.ComplexShape):
            msg = (
                f"Inputted geometry is not of type pinnjax.ComplexShape, "
                f"rather {type(geometry)}."
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)
        else:
            if self.spatial_dimensions != len(geometry.origin):
                msg = "Inputted geometry DOES NOT share equivalent spatial dimensions."
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if self.time != geometry.times:
                msg = "Inputted geometry DOES NOT share equivalent 'time'."
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            self.geometry = geometry

        # ------------------- Model -------------------
        if model is None:
            input_dimensions = int(self.spatial_dimensions + int(self.time is not None))
            if topology is None:
                if output_dimensions is None:
                    output_dimensions = 1
                self.topology = (input_dimensions, 64, 64, 64, 64, output_dimensions)
            elif isinstance(topology, tuple):
                if not all(isinstance(val, int) for val in topology):
                    msg = f"Not all values in 'topology: {topology}' are integers."
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if (
                    output_dimensions is not None
                    and output_dimensions != topology[-1]
                    and verbosity
                ):
                    msg = (
                        "Inputted 'output_dimensions': %s DO NOT equal "
                        "'topology' last dimension: %s. "
                        "Build proceeds: 'topology' controls."
                    )
                    _CONFIG.logger.warning(msg, output_dimensions, topology[-1])

                output_dimensions = topology[-1]
                self.topology = topology
            else:
                msg = (
                    f"Inputted topology is not of type Tuple, rather {type(topology)}."
                )
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

            self.input_dimensions = input_dimensions
            self.output_dimensions = output_dimensions

            if activation is None:
                self.activation = pinnjax.Activation(jax.nn.relu, kwargs={})
            elif isinstance(activation, pinnjax.Activation):
                self.activation = activation
            else:
                msg = (
                    f"Inputted activation is not of type pinnjax.Activation,"
                    f" rather {type(activation)}."
                )
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

            if initialization is None:
                self.initialization = None
            elif not isinstance(initialization, pinnjax.Initialization):
                msg = (
                    f"Inputted initialization is not of type pinnjax.Initialization,"
                    f" rather {type(initialization)}."
                )
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)
            else:
                self.initialization = initialization

            # ------------------- Optimization -------------------
            if optimization is None:
                self.input_transformation = (
                    input_transformation
                    if isinstance(input_transformation, pinnjax.InputTransformation)
                    else pinnjax.IdentityInputTransform()
                )
                self.output_transformation = (
                    output_transformation
                    if isinstance(output_transformation, pinnjax.OutputTransformation)
                    else pinnjax.IdentityOutputTransformation()
                )
                if hard_constraint is None:
                    self.hard_constraint = pinnjax.IdentityHardConstraint()
                else:
                    if isinstance(hard_constraint, tuple):
                        if not all(
                            isinstance(c, pinnjax.HardConstraint)
                            for c in hard_constraint
                        ):
                            msg = (
                                "One or more of the hard constraints is not of type "
                                "pinnjax.HardConstraint."
                            )
                            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                            raise ValueError(msg)
                    elif not isinstance(hard_constraint, pinnjax.HardConstraint):
                        msg = (
                            f"Inputted 'hard_constraint' "
                            f"is not of type pinnjax.HardConstraint, "
                            f"rather {type(hard_constraint)}."
                        )
                        _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                        raise TypeError(msg)
                    self.hard_constraint = hard_constraint
                self.optimization = pinnjax.Optimization(
                    input_transformation=self.input_transformation,
                    output_transformation=self.output_transformation,
                    hard_constraint=self.hard_constraint,
                )
            elif not isinstance(optimization, pinnjax.Optimization):
                msg = (
                    f"Inputted 'optimization' is not of type pinnjax.Optimization, "
                    f"rather {type(optimization)}."
                )
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)
            else:
                self.optimization = optimization
                self.input_transformation = optimization.input_transformation
                self.output_transformation = optimization.output_transformation
                self.hard_constraint = optimization.hard_constraint

            if seed is None:
                self.seed = _CONFIG.SEED
            elif isinstance(seed, int):
                self.seed = seed
            else:
                msg = f"Inputted 'seed' is NOT of type int, rather {type(seed)}"
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

            key, subkey = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(self.seed), 2)
            self.model = pinnjax.FNN(
                subkey,
                self.domain,
                self.topology,
                self.activation,
                initialization=self.initialization,
                optimization=self.optimization,
            )

        elif isinstance(model, pinnjax.NeuralNetwork):
            self.model = model
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Inputted 'model' is not of type pinnjax.NeuralNetwork, "
                f"rather {type(model)}"
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)

        # ------------------- Training -------------------
        if training is None:
            self.learning_rate = (
                learning_rate if isinstance(learning_rate, (float, Callable)) else 1e-2
            )
            self.optimizer = (
                optimizer
                if isinstance(optimizer, pinnjax.Optimizer)
                else pinnjax.Optimizer(
                    optax.adam,
                    kwargs={"learning_rate": self.learning_rate},
                )
            )
            self.epochs = epochs if isinstance(epochs, int) else 1000
            self.train_mode = train_mode if train_mode in ["class", "type"] else "class"
            self.loss_scale = loss_scale if isinstance(loss_scale, float) else 1.0
            self.priority = priority if isinstance(priority, tuple) else None

            self.use_adaptive_weights = (
                use_adaptive_weights
                if isinstance(use_adaptive_weights, bool)
                else False
            )
            self.adaptive_alpha = adaptive_alpha if self.use_adaptive_weights else 0.0
            self.update_weights_every = (
                update_weights_every if self.use_adaptive_weights else 0
            )
            self.update_weights_after = (
                update_weights_after if self.use_adaptive_weights else 0
            )

            self.balance_magnitudes = (
                balance_magnitudes if isinstance(balance_magnitudes, bool) else False
            )
            self.magnitude_clip = magnitude_clip if self.balance_magnitudes else 0.0

            self.early_stopping = (
                early_stopping if isinstance(early_stopping, bool) else False
            )
            self.patience = patience if self.early_stopping else 0
            self.rel_tolerance = rel_tolerance if self.early_stopping else 0.0

            self.training = pinnjax.Training(
                optimizer=self.optimizer,
                epochs=self.epochs,
                train_mode=self.train_mode,
                loss_scale=self.loss_scale,
                priority=self.priority,
                use_adaptive_weights=self.use_adaptive_weights,
                adaptive_alpha=self.adaptive_alpha,
                update_weights_every=self.update_weights_every,
                update_weights_after=self.update_weights_after,
                balance_magnitudes=self.balance_magnitudes,
                magnitude_clip=self.magnitude_clip,
                early_stopping=self.early_stopping,
                patience=self.patience,
                rel_tolerance=self.rel_tolerance,
            )

        elif isinstance(training, pinnjax.Training):
            self.training = training
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Inputted 'training' is NOT of type 'pinnjax.Training', "
                f"rather {type(training)}"
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)

        if verbosity:
            _CONFIG.logger.info(self.model)
            _CONFIG.logger.info(self.training)

    def edit(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        """Not yet implemented."""

class Shape(ABC):
    """Primitive Base Class for which all Shapes derive.

    Attributes:
        spatial_dims: number of spatial dimensions.
        dims: total number of dimensions, including temporal.
        times: Optional [`pinnjax.Time`][pinnjax.Time] object.
        samples: Array of collocation points.
            Populated after calling `sample()`.
        n_points: Number of collocation points.
        residual_function: Assigned [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual] object.
        loss_function: Assigned [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss] object.
        loss_val: Most recently calculated loss using assigned
            [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss] object.

    """

    spatial_dims: int = 0
    dims: int = 0
    times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None
    samples: Array | None = None
    n_points: int = 0
    residual_function: pinnjax.Residual | None = None
    loss_function: pinnjax.Loss | None = None
    loss_val: Array | None = None
    origin: Array | None = None

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.shapes = None

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        """Return (min, max) arrays for sampling.

        Raises:
            NotImplementedError: Always.

        """
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> None:
        """Map unit-cube samples to uniform samples in the shape.

        Raises:
            NotImplementedError: Always.

        """
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def sample(
        self,
        method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
        sampling_value: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Array, int]:
        """Generate collocation points within the Shape.
            The number of points collocated is determined by the sampling_value
            and varies by [`pinnjax.SamplingMethod`][pinnjax.SamplingMethod] `mode`.

        Args:
            method: A [`pinnjax.SamplingMethod`][pinnjax.SamplingMethod] object.
            sampling_value: Determines the number of points to sample based
                on the `mode` provided at initialization of the `SamplingMethod`.
                Default `mode` is `point_count`.
        Returns:
            samples: Array of collocation points.
            n_points: Number of collocation points.

        """
        if sampling_value is None:
            sampling_value = 1000

        self.samples = jnp.asarray(method(self, sampling_value), dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE)
        self.n_points = len(self.samples)

        return self.samples, self.n_points

    def estimate_nsamples(self, value: float) -> int:
        """Determine the equivalent number of samples given a uniform-grid sampling.

        Args:
            value: Distance between points in a uniform-grid sample of the same Shape.

        Raises:
            NotImplementedError: Always.

        """
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        msg = "Not implemented."
        _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
        raise NotImplementedError

    def normal(self) -> Array:
        """Compute the normal vector.

        Raises:
            NotImplementedError: Always.

        """
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def set_residual(self, residual: pinnjax.Residual) -> None:
        """Bind the [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual] object to this Shape.

        Args:
            residual: A [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual] object.

        """
        self.residual_function = (
            residual.bind(self) if hasattr(residual, "bind") else residual
        )

    def has_residual(self) -> bool:
        """Check if a [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual] has already been bound.

        Returns:
            bool: Whether the Shape has a [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual].

        """
        return self.residual_function is not None

    def residuals(self, ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators) -> Array:
        """Calculate the residual values for all collocation points using the bound
            [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual].

        Args:
            ops: A [`DifferentialOperators`][pinnjax.DifferentialOperators] object.


        Returns:
            residuals: Array of residual values for each collocation point.

        Raises:
            InputError: If no collocation points have been generated for this Shape.
            InputError: If no [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual]
                has been bound to this Shape.

        """
        if self.samples is None:
            msg = (
                "There are no samples associated with this shape. Call .sample() first."
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise InputError(msg)

        if not self.has_residual():
            msg = (
                "There is no residual function associated with this shape. "
                "Call .set_residual() first."
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise InputError(msg)
        return self.residual_function(self.samples, ops)

    def set_loss(self, loss_function: pinnjax.Loss) -> None:
        """Assign a [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss] object to this Shape.

        Args:
            loss_function: A [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss] object.

        """
        self.loss_function = loss_function

    def has_loss(self) -> bool:
        """Check if a [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss] has already been bound.

        Returns:
            bool: Whether the Shape has a [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss].

        """
        return self.loss_function is not None

    def loss(self, residuals: Array) -> Array:
        """Calculate the loss for all collocation points using the bound
            [`pinnjax.Loss`][pinnjax.Loss].

        Args:
            residuals: Array of residual values for each collocation point.

        """
        if not self.has_loss():
            msg = (
                "There is no loss function associated with this shape. "
                "Call .set_loss first."
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise InputError(msg)

        self.loss_val = self.loss_function(residuals)
        return self.loss_val

    def residual_and_losses(
        self,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
        ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators,
    ) -> Array:
        """Calculate the loss and residuals. Return the loss."""
        residuals = self.residuals(ops)
        return self.loss(residuals)

    @abstractmethod
    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

def sample(
    self,
    method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
    sampling_value: float | None = None,
) -> tuple[Array, int]:
    """Generate collocation points within the Shape.
        The number of points collocated is determined by the sampling_value
        and varies by [`pinnjax.SamplingMethod`][pinnjax.SamplingMethod] `mode`.

    Args:
        method: A [`pinnjax.SamplingMethod`][pinnjax.SamplingMethod] object.
        sampling_value: Determines the number of points to sample based
            on the `mode` provided at initialization of the `SamplingMethod`.
            Default `mode` is `point_count`.
    Returns:
        samples: Array of collocation points.
        n_points: Number of collocation points.

    """
    if sampling_value is None:
        sampling_value = 1000

    self.samples = jnp.asarray(method(self, sampling_value), dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE)
    self.n_points = len(self.samples)

    return self.samples, self.n_points

def residuals(self, ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators) -> Array:
    """Calculate the residual values for all collocation points using the bound
        [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual].

    Args:
        ops: A [`DifferentialOperators`][pinnjax.DifferentialOperators] object.


    Returns:

        InputError: If no collocation points have been generated for this Shape.
        InputError: If no [`pinnjax.Residual`][pinnjax.Residual]
            has been bound to this Shape.

    """
    if self.samples is None:
        msg = (
            "There are no samples associated with this shape. Call .sample() first."
        )
        _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
        raise InputError(msg)

    if not self.has_residual():
        msg = (
            "There is no residual function associated with this shape. "
            "Call .set_residual() first."
        )
        _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
        raise InputError(msg)
    return self.residual_function(self.samples, ops)

class Dot(Shape):
    def __init__(
        self,
        a: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.a = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.asarray(a, dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE))
        self.spatial_dims = self.a.size
        self.dims = self.a.size

        if isinstance(times, (int, float)):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float) -> int:
        # 1 is not enough samples.
        if self.times is None:
            return 1
        return int(jnp.round(self.times.range() / self.tstep))

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        msg = "Not implemented."
        _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
        raise NotImplementedError

    def normal(self) -> Array:
        if self.a.shape[0] != 1:
            msg = "Dot.normal() only implemented for 1D"
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)

        x = float(self.a[0])
        if jnp.isclose(x, -1.0):
            return jnp.array([-1.0])
        if jnp.isclose(x, 1.0):
            return jnp.array([1.0])
        return jnp.sign(jnp.array([x], dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE))

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        a = jnp.expand_dims(self.a, axis=0)  # shape (1, ndim)
        return a, a

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        spatial = self.a

        if self.single_time is not None:
            point = jnp.concatenate([spatial, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
        elif self.times is not None:
            t_param = unit_samples[:, -1]
            time = self.tmin + t_param * (self.tmax - self.tmin)
            return jnp.concatenate(
                [jnp.tile(spatial, (unit_samples.shape[0], 1)), time[:, None]],
                axis=1,
            )
        else:
            point = spatial

        return point[jnp.newaxis, :]

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if self.a.size == TWO_DIMENSIONAL:  # 2D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots()

            ax.scatter(
                *self.a,
                s=50,
            )

            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.grid(True)
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

            if show:
                plt.show()

        else:  # 3D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig = plt.figure()
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

            ax.scatter(
                *self.a,
                s=50,
            )

            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")

            if show:
                plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class Line(Shape):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        end: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.origin = jnp.atleast_1d(
            jnp.array(origin, dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE),
        )  # Ensure proper dtype
        self.end = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.array(end, dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE))
        self.spatial_dims = self.origin.size
        self.dims = self.origin.size

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, (int, float)):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        return jnp.linalg.norm(self.end - self.origin)

    def normal(self) -> Array:
        """Normal vector to the line (perpendicular)."""
        if self.origin.shape[0] == TWO_DIMENSIONAL:
            direction = self.end - self.origin
            # Perpendicular in 2D: rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise
            normal_2d = jnp.array([-direction[1], direction[0]], dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE)
            norm_magnitude = jnp.linalg.norm(normal_2d)
            return jnp.where(
                norm_magnitude > 1e-12,
                normal_2d / norm_magnitude,
                jnp.array([0.0, 1.0], dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE),
            )  # Fallback
        msg = "Normal for 3D lines not implemented."
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Normal for 3D lines not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        lower = jnp.minimum(self.origin, self.end)
        upper = jnp.maximum(self.origin, self.end)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time point
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Time range
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.tmin])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.tmax])])

        return lower, upper

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        # unit_samples shape (..., 1) for spatial parameter
        t_param = unit_samples[..., 0:1]  # Parameter along line [0,1]

        # Interpolate along line: a + t*(b-a)
        spatial = self.origin + t_param * (self.end - self.origin)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Add constant time dimension
            time = jnp.full((*unit_samples.shape[:-1], 1), self.single_time)
            return jnp.concatenate([spatial, time], axis=-1)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Add time range
            t_time = unit_samples[..., 1:2]  # Time parameter [0,1]
            time = self.tmin + t_time * (self.tmax - self.tmin)
            return jnp.concatenate([spatial, time], axis=-1)
        return spatial

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float = 0.1) -> int:
        length = jnp.linalg.norm(self.end - self.origin)
        n_space = jnp.round(length / res)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time instant - only spatial samples needed
            return int(n_space)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Time range - multiply by time samples
            n_time = jnp.round((self.tmax - self.tmin) / self.tstep)
            return int(n_space * n_time)
        return int(n_space)

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if self.origin.size == 1:
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots()

            ax.plot([self.origin, self.end], [0, 0], "b-", linewidth=2)
            ax.plot([self.origin, self.end], [0, 0], "bo", markersize=5)

        elif self.origin.size == TWO_DIMENSIONAL:  # 2D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots()

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                "b-",
                linewidth=2,
            )
            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                "bo",
                markersize=5,
            )

            if show_normals:
                midpoint = (self.origin + self.end) / 2
                n = self.normal() * normal_scale
                ax.arrow(
                    float(midpoint[0]),
                    float(midpoint[1]),
                    float(n[0]),
                    float(n[1]),
                    head_width=0.1,
                    head_length=0.1,
                    fc="red",
                    ec="red",
                )

            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.grid(True)
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

            if show:
                plt.show()

        elif self.origin.size == THREE_DIMENSIONAL:  # 3D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig = plt.figure()
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                "b-",
                linewidth=2,
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                c="blue",
                s=50,
            )

            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")

        else:
            msg = "Unsupported dimension size."
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise InputError(msg)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class Triangle(Shape):
    # TODO(@mjryande): Ensure functionality with an example.
    def __init__(
        self,
        a: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        b: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        c: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.a = jnp.array(a)
        self.b = jnp.array(b)
        self.c = jnp.array(c)
        self.spatial_dims = 2
        self.dims = 2

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, (int, float)):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        lower = jnp.minimum(jnp.minimum(self.a, self.b), self.c)
        upper = jnp.maximum(jnp.maximum(self.a, self.b), self.c)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time point
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Time range
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.tmin])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.tmax])])

        return lower, upper

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time instant case
            u_space = unit_samples[:, :2]
            b0, b1, b2 = _sample_triangle_barycentric(u_space)

            spatial = b0[:, None] * self.a + b1[:, None] * self.b + b2[:, None] * self.c
            time = jnp.full((spatial.shape[0], 1), self.single_time)
            return jnp.concatenate([spatial, time], axis=1)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Time range case
            u_space = unit_samples[:, :2]
            u_time = unit_samples[:, -1]  # Use -1 for time, always last!
            b0, b1, b2 = _sample_triangle_barycentric(u_space)

            spatial = b0[:, None] * self.a + b1[:, None] * self.b + b2[:, None] * self.c
            time = self.tmin + u_time * (self.tmax - self.tmin)
            return jnp.concatenate([spatial, time[:, None]], axis=1)
        # No time dimension
        b0, b1, b2 = _sample_triangle_barycentric(unit_samples)
        return b0[:, None] * self.a + b1[:, None] * self.b + b2[:, None] * self.c

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float = 0.1) -> int:
        area = 0.5 * jnp.linalg.norm(jnp.cross(self.b - self.a, self.c - self.a))
        n_space = jnp.round(area / res**2)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time instant - only spatial samples needed
            return int(n_space)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Time range - multiply by time samples
            n_time = jnp.round((self.tmax - self.tmin) / self.tstep)
            return int(n_space * n_time)
        return int(n_space)

    def normal(self) -> Array:
        va, vb, vc = _as3(self.a), _as3(self.b), _as3(self.c)
        n = jnp.cross(vb - va, vc - va)
        return n / jnp.linalg.norm(n)

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        va, vb, vc = _as3(self.a), _as3(self.b), _as3(self.c)

        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        # Plot triangle edges
        pts = jnp.stack([va, vb, vc, va])
        ax.plot(pts[:, 0], pts[:, 1], pts[:, 2], color="black", marker="o")

        # Plot normal if requested
        if show_normals:
            _CONFIG.logger.warning("Triangle Normals don't function properly.")
            centroid = (va + vb + vc) / 3.0
            n = self.normal() * normal_scale

            ax.quiver(
                centroid[0],
                centroid[1],
                centroid[2],
                n[0],
                n[1],
                n[2],
                color="blue",
                linewidth=2,
            )

        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")
        ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class Rectangle(Shape):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        edge1: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        edge2: tuple[float, ...] | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.origin = jnp.array(origin)
        self.edge1 = jnp.array(edge1)
        self.edge2 = jnp.array(edge2)
        self.spatial_dims = self.origin.size
        self.dims = self.origin.size

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, (int, float)):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        return jnp.linalg.norm(jnp.cross(self.edge1, self.edge2))

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        # Compute all 4 corners, then min/max
        corners = jnp.stack(
            [
                self.origin,
                self.origin + self.edge1,
                self.origin + self.edge2,
                self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge2,
            ],
        )
        lower = jnp.min(corners, axis=0)
        upper = jnp.max(corners, axis=0)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time point
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Time range
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.tmin])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.tmax])])

        return lower, upper

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        # Spatial transformation
        pt = (
            self.origin
            + unit_samples[..., 0:1] * self.edge1
            + unit_samples[..., 1:2] * self.edge2
        )

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Add constant time dimension
            t = jnp.full((*unit_samples.shape[:-1], 1), self.single_time)
            pt = jnp.concatenate([pt, t], axis=-1)
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Add time range
            t = self.tmin + unit_samples[..., 2:3] * (self.tmax - self.tmin)
            pt = jnp.concatenate([pt, t], axis=-1)

        return pt

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float) -> int:
        len1 = jnp.linalg.norm(self.edge1)
        len2 = jnp.linalg.norm(self.edge2)
        n_space = jnp.maximum(int(jnp.round(len1 / res)), 2) * jnp.maximum(
            int(jnp.round(len2 / res)),
            2,
        )

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time instant - only spatial samples needed
            return int(n_space)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Time range - multiply by time samples
            n_time = jnp.maximum(jnp.round((self.tmax - self.tmin) / self.tstep), 2)
            return int(n_space * n_time)
        return int(n_space)

    def normal(self) -> Array:
        e1, e2 = _as3(self.edge1), _as3(self.edge2)
        n = jnp.cross(e1, e2)
        return n / jnp.linalg.norm(n)

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        # TODO: Always plots in 3D.
        o = _as3(self.origin)
        e1 = _as3(self.edge1)
        e2 = _as3(self.edge2)

        # 4 corners in order
        v0 = o
        v1 = o + e1
        v2 = o + e1 + e2
        v3 = o + e2

        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        # Plot rectangle edges
        pts = jnp.stack([v0, v1, v2, v3, v0])
        ax.plot(pts[:, 0], pts[:, 1], pts[:, 2], color="black", marker="o")

        # Plot normal if requested
        if show_normals:
            centroid = (v0 + v1 + v2 + v3) / 4.0
            n = self.normal() * normal_scale
            ax.quiver(
                centroid[0],
                centroid[1],
                centroid[2],
                n[0],
                n[1],
                n[2],
                color="blue",
                linewidth=2,
            )

        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")
        ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class Box(Shape, ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: tuple[float, float, float] | Array,
        edge1: tuple[float, float, float] | Array,
        edge2: tuple[float, float, float] | Array,
        edge3: tuple[float, float, float] | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.origin = jnp.array(origin)
        self.edge1 = jnp.array(edge1)
        self.edge2 = jnp.array(edge2)
        self.edge3 = jnp.array(edge3)
        self.spatial_dims = self.origin.size
        self.dims = self.origin.size

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, (int, float)):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        return jnp.abs(jnp.dot(self.edge1, jnp.cross(self.edge2, self.edge3)))

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        # Compute all 8 corners, then min/max
        corners = jnp.stack(
            [
                self.origin,
                self.origin + self.edge1,
                self.origin + self.edge2,
                self.origin + self.edge3,
                self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge2,
                self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge3,
                self.origin + self.edge2 + self.edge3,
                self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge2 + self.edge3,
            ],
        )
        lower = jnp.min(corners, axis=0)
        upper = jnp.max(corners, axis=0)

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time point
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.single_time])])
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Time range
            lower = jnp.concatenate([lower, jnp.array([self.tmin])])
            upper = jnp.concatenate([upper, jnp.array([self.tmax])])

        return lower, upper

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool | None = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        domain = pinnjax.Domain.from_obb(
            self.origin,
            self.edge1,
            self.edge2,
            self.edge3,
            times=self.times,
        )

        fig, ax = domain.draw(show=show, fig=fig, ax=ax)

        return fig, ax

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        # Spatial transformation
        pt = (
            self.origin
            + unit_samples[..., 0:1] * self.edge1
            + unit_samples[..., 1:2] * self.edge2
            + unit_samples[..., 2:3] * self.edge3
        )

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Add constant time dimension
            t = jnp.full((*unit_samples.shape[:-1], 1), self.single_time)
            pt = jnp.concatenate([pt, t], axis=-1)
        elif self.times is not None:
            # Add time range
            t = self.tmin + unit_samples[..., 3:4] * (self.tmax - self.tmin)
            pt = jnp.concatenate([pt, t], axis=-1)

        return pt

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float) -> int:
        len1, len2, len3 = (
            jnp.linalg.norm(self.edge1),
            jnp.linalg.norm(self.edge2),
            jnp.linalg.norm(self.edge3),
        )
        n_space = (
            jnp.maximum(jnp.round(len1 / res), 2)
            * jnp.maximum(jnp.round(len2 / res), 2)
            * jnp.maximum(jnp.round(len3 / res), 2)
        )

        if self.single_time is not None:
            # Single time instant - only spatial samples needed
            return int(n_space)
        if self.times is not None:
            # Time range - multiply by time samples
            n_time = jnp.maximum(jnp.round((self.tmax - self.tmin) / self.tstep), 2)
            return int(n_space * n_time)
        return int(n_space)

class ComplexShape(Shape, ABC):
    def __init__(self, shapes: list[Shape], *, times: pinnjax.Time = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        if not isinstance(shapes, list):
            shapes = list(shapes)
        self.shapes: list[Shape] = shapes
        self.times: pinnjax.Time = times
        self.path: None | pinnjax.Path = None
        self.class_map: dict = {}
        self.type_map: dict = {}
        self.kinds_class: tuple[int, ...] = ()
        self.kinds_type: tuple[int, ...] = ()
        self.labels_class: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        self.labels_type: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        self.loss_dictionary = {}
        self.final_loss_dictionary = {}
        self.best_epoch: int = 0
        self.last_epoch: int = 0
        self.loss_weights: Iterable = []

    def assign_residuals(
        self,
        residuals: pinnjax.Residual | list[pinnjax.Residual],
        *,
        class_map: dict | None = None,
        type_map: dict | None = None,
        labels_class: list | None = None,
        labels_type: list | None = None,
        kinds_class: list | None = None,
        kinds_type: list | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if isinstance(residuals, pinnjax.Residual):
            residuals = [residuals] * len(self.shapes)

        if len(residuals) != len(self.shapes):
            msg = "Length of Residuals must EQUAL length of Shapes"
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise InputError(msg)

        if class_map is None or type_map is None:
            class_map, type_map = {}, {}
        if labels_class is None or labels_type is None:
            labels_class, labels_type = [], []
        if kinds_class is None or kinds_type is None:
            kinds_class, kinds_type = [], []

        for _i, (shape, residual) in enumerate(
            zip(self.shapes, residuals, strict=True)
        ):
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                shape.assign_residuals(
                    residual,
                    class_map=class_map,
                    type_map=type_map,
                    labels_class=labels_class,
                    labels_type=labels_type,
                    kinds_class=kinds_class,
                    kinds_type=kinds_type,
                )
                class_map, type_map = shape.class_map, shape.type_map
                labels_class, labels_type = shape.labels_class, shape.labels_type
                kinds_class, kinds_type = shape.kinds_class, shape.kinds_type
            else:
                shape.set_residual(residual)

                # class-level tag (exact residual class)
                cls = residual.__class__
                if cls not in class_map:
                    class_map[cls] = len(class_map)
                    labels_class.append(cls.__name__)
                kinds_class.append(class_map[cls])

                # type-level tag (overarching category)
                if isinstance(residual, pinnjax.BoundaryCondition):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.BoundaryCondition
                elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation
                elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.InitialCondition):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.InitialCondition
                else:
                    msg = f"Unsupported residual type: {type(residual)}"
                    _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                    raise TypeError(msg)

                if type_cls not in type_map:
                    type_map[type_cls] = len(type_map)
                    labels_type.append(type_cls.__name__)
                kinds_type.append(type_map[type_cls])

        self.class_map = class_map
        self.type_map = type_map
        self.kinds_class = tuple(kinds_class)
        self.kinds_type = tuple(kinds_type)
        self.labels_class = tuple(labels_class)
        self.labels_type = tuple(labels_type)

        if not self.loss_dictionary:
            self.loss_dictionary = {
                "class": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_class},
                "type": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_type},
            }

    def print_samples(self) -> None:
        for i, s in enumerate(self.shapes):
            _CONFIG.logger.info(
                "Shape %d (%s): %d collocation points",
                i + 1,
                s.__class__.__name__,
                s.n_points,
            )

    def final_loss(self) -> dict:
        if not self.loss_dictionary:
            msg = "The Loss Dictionary not yet populated. Train the model first."
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if self.final_loss_dictionary:
            return self.final_loss_dictionary

        self.final_loss_dictionary = final_loss(self.loss_dictionary)

        return self.final_loss_dictionary

    def assign_loss(self, loss: pinnjax.Loss) -> None:
        # single loss for all shapes.
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    s.set_loss(loss)
            else:
                shape.set_loss(loss)

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def add_path_shape(
        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def samples(
        self,
        method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
        sampling_values: float | list[float] | None = None,
        *,
        overwrite: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        n_shapes = len(self.shapes)
        if sampling_values is None:
            sampling_values = [None] * n_shapes
        if isinstance(sampling_values, float | int):
            sampling_values = [sampling_values] * n_shapes

        if n_shapes != len(sampling_values):
            msg = (
                f"Number of Shapes: {n_shapes} does not equal "
                f"number of sampling_values: {sampling_values}"
            )
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        self.n_points = 0
        for shape, value in zip(self.shapes, sampling_values, strict=True):
            if isinstance(shape, pinnjax.ComplexShape):
                shape.samples(method, value)
                self.n_points += shape.n_points
            elif shape.n_points == 0 or overwrite is True:
                _, x = shape.sample(
                    method,
                    value,
                )  # sampled points are stored in the objects
                self.n_points += x
            else:
                _CONFIG.logger.warning("Shape already sampled.")

    def residual_and_losses(
        self,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
        ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators,
    ) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array]:
        samples_list = tuple(s.samples for s in self.shapes)

        # static callables:
        residual_functions = tuple(s.residual_function for s in self.shapes)
        loss_functions = tuple(
            (s.loss_function or pinnjax.ResidualMSError()) for s in self.shapes
        )

        kinds_class = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_class, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_class = int(max(self.kinds_class) + 1)
        kinds_type = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_type, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_type = int(max(self.kinds_type) + 1)

        total, by_class, by_type = _losses_kernel(
            samples_list=samples_list,
            residual_functions=residual_functions,
            loss_functions=loss_functions,
            kinds_class=kinds_class,
            kinds_type=kinds_type,
            n_class=n_class,
            n_type=n_type,
            ops=ops,
        )

        return total, by_class, by_type

    def plot_loss(
        self,
        *,
        mode: str = "class",
        title: str | None = None,
        show_best_epoch: bool | None = True,
        show_grid: bool = True,
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool = False,
        save_location: Path | str | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        fig, ax = pinnjax.plot_loss(
            self.loss_dictionary,
            mode=mode,
            title=title,
            best_epoch=self.best_epoch if show_best_epoch else None,
            show_grid=show_grid,
            show=show,
            save=save,
            save_location=save_location,
            save_name=save_name,
        )

        return fig, ax

    def unpack(self, *, flatten: bool = True) -> None:
        # The purpose of this function is unpack internal ComplexShapes
        # into a single ComplexShape.
        for _i, shape in enumerate(list(self.shapes)):
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                self.shapes.remove(shape)
                if flatten:
                    valid, _shapes, _residual, _loss = shape.verify_repetition(
                        set_return=True,
                    )
                    if valid:
                        _shape = next(iter(_shapes), None)
                        if _shape is not None:
                            domain = shape.encompassing_domain()
                            obb = domain.to_obb()
                            flattened_shape = _shape(*obb, times=domain.times)
                            if _residual:
                                flattened_shape.set_residual(_residual)
                            if _loss:
                                flattened_shape.set_loss(_loss)
                            samples = []
                            n_points = 0
                            for s in shape.shapes:
                                if s.samples is not None:
                                    samples.append(s.samples)
                                    n_points += round(s.n_points)

                            if len(samples) > 0:
                                flattened_shape.samples = jnp.vstack(samples)
                            else:
                                flattened_shape.samples = None

                            flattened_shape.n_points = round(n_points)
                            self.shapes.append(flattened_shape)
                    else:
                        _CONFIG.logger.warning(
                            "Complex Shape Identified, but repetition not verified.",
                        )
                else:
                    for s in shape.shapes:
                        self.shapes.append(s)

    def encompassing_domain(self) -> pinnjax.Domain:
        # returns a pinnjax.Domain which encompasses all shapes.
        mins = []
        maxs = []
        for shape in self.shapes:
            bmin, bmax = shape.bounds()
            mins.append(bmin)
            maxs.append(bmax)

        mins = jnp.stack(mins)
        maxs = jnp.stack(maxs)

        # compute overall min/max per column
        mins = jnp.min(mins, axis=0)
        maxs = jnp.max(maxs, axis=0)

        if self.times is not None:
            return pinnjax.Domain(
                min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
                max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
                times=self.times,
            )
        times = pinnjax.Time(min=mins[-1], max=maxs[-1], step=0.1)
        return pinnjax.Domain(
            min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
            max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
            times=times,
        )

    def verify_repetition(
        self,
        *,
        set_return: bool = False,
    ) -> bool | tuple[bool, set, set, set]:
        shapes = set()
        residual = set()
        loss = set()
        for shape in self.shapes:
            shapes.add(type(shape))
            if shape.has_residual():
                residual.add(shape.residual_function)
            if shape.has_loss():
                loss.add(shape.loss_function)

        valid = all(len(s) <= 1 for s in (shapes, residual, loss))
        if set_return:
            return valid, shapes, residual, loss
        return valid

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        # Determine if we need 2D or 3D plotting by checking the shapes
        needs_3d = any(
            (hasattr(shape, "spatial_dims") and shape.spatial_dims >= THREE_DIMENSIONAL)
            for shape in self.shapes
        )

        # Create appropriate axes if not provided
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            if needs_3d:
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
            else:
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111)

        # Draw each shape
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if hasattr(shape, "draw"):
                try:
                    fig, ax = shape.draw(
                        show_normals=show_normals,
                        normal_scale=normal_scale,
                        fig=fig,
                        ax=ax,
                        show=False,
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
                    _CONFIG.logger.warning(
                        "Could not draw shape %s: %s",
                        type(shape).__name__,
                        e,
                    )

        # Set appropriate properties based on 2D vs 3D
        if needs_3d:
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")
            ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])
        else:
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.grid(True)
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

        ax.set_title(f"Complex Shape: {len(self.shapes)} components")

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class BoundedLine(ComplexShape, ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        end: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
        *,
        initial: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.origin = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.asarray(origin, dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE))
        self.end = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.asarray(end, dtype=_CONFIG.DTYPE))
        self.spatial_dims = self.origin.size
        self.dims = self.origin.size

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, float):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None

        line = Line(origin=origin, end=end, times=self.times)
        dot_a = Dot(a=origin, times=self.times)
        dot_b = Dot(a=end, times=self.times)
        shapes = [line, dot_a, dot_b]

        super().__init__(shapes)

        self.initials_set = False
        if initial:
            self.add_initial()

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        if not self.initials_set:
            self.shapes.append(
                Line(origin=self.origin, end=self.end, times=self.times.min),
            )
            self.initials_set = True
            return
        _CONFIG.logger.warning(
            "Initial Domain has already been added to this ComplexShape."
        )
        return

    def add_path_shape(
        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        _CONFIG.logger.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def show_samples(
        self,
        *,
        color: str = "dodgerblue",
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            if self.spatial_dims == THREE_DIMENSIONAL:
                fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
            else:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

        for shape in self.shapes:
            _samples = shape.samples[:, : self.spatial_dims]

            if self.spatial_dims == 1:
                _samples = jnp.column_stack(
                    [_samples[:, 0], jnp.zeros_like(_samples[:, 0])],
                )
                ax.scatter(*_samples.T, color=color, marker=",", s=2)

            elif self.spatial_dims in {TWO_DIMENSIONAL, THREE_DIMENSIONAL}:
                ax.scatter(*_samples.T, color=color, marker=",", s=2)

            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported spatial dimension: {self.spatial_dims}"
                _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_samples: bool = False,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if self.origin.size == 1:
            # 1D: draw on x-axis
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

            ax.plot([self.origin[0], self.end[0]], [0, 0], "b-")
            ax.scatter([self.origin[0], self.end[0]], [0, 0], c="red")
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_yticks([])

        elif self.origin.size == TWO_DIMENSIONAL:
            # 2D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                "b-",
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                c="red",
            )
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

        elif self.origin.size == THREE_DIMENSIONAL:
            # 3D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                "b-",
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                c="red",
            )
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")
            ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])

        else:
            msg = f"Unsupported dimension: {self.origin.size}"
            _CONFIG.logger.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if show_samples:
            fig, ax = self.show_samples(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax
